question: Should durable multi-hop spawn lineage be canonical session metadata, or should TaskFlow become the sole execution-DAG contract with sessions exposing only direct parentage?
rationale: Both session state and TaskFlow now represent related lineage concepts; implementation should not introduce a second ambiguous trace identity or parallel source of truth without selecting the permanent owner boundary.

options.title: Canonical Session Lineage
options.body: Add rootSessionKey and a distinct spawnChainId to persisted session metadata, then bridge TaskFlow records to that identity.

options.title: TaskFlow-Only Lineage
options.body: Keep sessions limited to direct parent/depth fields and extend TaskFlow plus its projections to cover all nested spawned work.

options.title: Defer New Contract
options.body: Retain current direct lineage until a concrete chain consumer establishes the required identity and lifecycle semantics.

recommendation.title: Canonical Session Lineage
recommendation.body: Add rootSessionKey and a distinct spawnChainId to persisted session metadata, then bridge TaskFlow records to that identity.
